episodes.title: a Sunday in my life after leaving a cult | My First Vlog
episodes.description:
Can you be happy at 30, single, childless, and have a dog who is your whole world? 🐾

In this video, Barb shares a glimpse into her Sunday routine with her Border Collie, Pixie, while reflecting on life after leaving a cult, finding her identity, and learning what happiness looks like outside the life she was raised to expect.

A few months ago, Barb seriously considered rehoming Pixie. Between the challenges of owning a high-energy dog, working toward financial stability, and questioning who she really was as a person, she wondered if having a dog was truly what she wanted. But through unexpected kindness, dog training, and a growing bond with Pixie, she began to realize just how much this little four-legged family member meant to her.

Now, her Sundays look a little different. Instead of spending the day in required religious studies, she gets to enjoy trail runs, time outdoors, sunsets, a little apartment reset, and simply making memories with her dog.

After growing up in a cult where her future was largely predetermined, Barb is learning to build a life on her own terms. At 30, she's single, childless, and embracing a future that looks nothing like the one she was raised to expect. And she's discovering that family, love, and happiness don't have to fit anyone else's definition.

Life isn't perfect, and there are still financial and personal struggles along the way. But things are getting better, and for the first time, the life she's building is one she's chosen for herself.

Maybe breaking generational cycles looks different for everyone. For Barb, it looks like a Sunday morning with Pixie, a home that feels a little more like home each year, and the freedom to decide what her own happiness means.

Thanks for spending part of your Sunday with Barb and Pixie! ❤️

#LifeAfterACult #SingleAt30 #LifeWithMyDog #BorderCollie #BreakingGenerationalCycles #Childfree #SoloLiving #FindingYourself

episodes.title: I Left a Cult 4.5 Years Ago. This Is My Life Now.
episodes.description:
Four and a half years ago, I left the FLDS. 

Leaving was the hardest thing I had ever done. But I didn't realize that building a life afterward would become its own kind of journey. 

In this video, I'm introducing myself, sharing a little where I came from, what my life looks like now, and what it has been like figuring out who I am outside of the world I grew up in.

This is the beginning of a new chapter, and I'm still figuring out what that looks like. 

Welcome to my new life!
